cues.zh: 所以我认为，总的来说，我们应该尽量减少这种地方的数量，
cues.en: So I would argue, in general, overall, we should try to minimize the number of places

cues.zh: 也就是必须处理异常的地方。
cues.en: where you have to handle exceptions.

cues.zh: 你无法完全消除它，
cues.en: You can't completely eliminate it,

cues.zh: 但尽量把它降到最低。
cues.en: but try to minimize that.

cues.zh: 而最好的情况，我发现你出人意料地经常能做到，
cues.en: And the best case of all, which I find you can do surprisingly often,

cues.zh: 就是直接重新定义语义，
cues.en: is simply to redefine the semantics,

cues.zh: 这样就不存在错误了。
cues.en: so that there is no error.

cues.zh: 根本不会有异常。
cues.en: There is no exception at all.

cues.zh: 这是最好的情况。它直接彻底消失了。
cues.en: That's the best. It's just gone completely.

cues.zh: 那我给你们举三个例子。
cues.en: So let me give you three examples of that.

cues.zh: 第一个，呃，很多年前我在设计 Tcl 脚本语言时，
cues.en: The first one, uh when I was designing the tickle scripting language many years ago,

cues.zh: 我引入了一个 unset 命令，用来删除一个或多个变量。
cues.en: and I introduced an unset command, which deletes one or more variables.

cues.zh: 做这个的时候，
cues.en: When I was doing this,

cues.zh: 我当时想，顺便说一句，这是一种经典的
cues.en: I thought, by the way, this is a classic

cues.zh: 人们会犯的错误，我当时想，
cues.en: mistake people, I thought,

cues.zh: 一个脑子正常的人，怎么会去删除一个不存在的变量呢？
cues.en: why in their right mind would anybody ever delete a variable that doesn't exist?

cues.zh: 这毫无道理。
cues.en: That makes no sense.

cues.zh: 所以，我打算抛出一个异常
cues.en: So, I'm going to throw an exception

cues.zh: 来处理这种情况。
cues.en: for that.

cues.zh: 结果发现，人们一直这么干。
cues.en: Well, it turns out people do that all the time.

cues.zh: 呃，比如，
cues.en: Uh, for example,

cues.zh: 你计算做到一半，决定干脆退出。
cues.en: you're halfway through a computation, you decide you just want to bail.

cues.zh: 于是你想清理掉自己可能弄出的一堆烂摊子。
cues.en: So you want to clean up all the mess you might have made.

cues.zh: 所以你逐个删除自己可能创建过的每个变量，但你并不知道自己实际已经创建了哪些。
cues.en: So you go through and delete every variable that you might have created, but you don't know which ones you actually got around to creating yet.

cues.zh: 所以其中有些并不存在。
cues.en: And so some of them don't exist.

cues.zh: 所以实际上，人们一直在抱怨这一点；事实上，如果你看看 Tcl 代码，
cues.en: So in practice, people complain about this all the time, and in fact, if you look at tickle code,

cues.zh: 我敢说，几乎每次调用 unset 命令，都被包在一个 catch 命令里，由它捕获异常
cues.en: I bet virtually every invocation of the unset command is wrapped in a catch command that will catch the exception

cues.zh: 并在异常发生时把它丢弃。
cues.en: and throw it away, when it happens.

cues.zh: 所以我本应该做的，
cues.en: So, what I should have done,

cues.zh: 其实，我也不知道为什么发现问题后没有修复它，这是我的第二个错误。
cues.en: in fact I I don't know why I didn't fix it once I found the problem, that was my second mistake.

cues.zh: 我本应该重新定义语义，让 unset 命令使变量
cues.en: What I should have done was redefine the semantics so that unset makes a variable

cues.zh: 不存在。
cues.en: not exist.

cues.zh: 如果你这么想，那好吧，如果变量本来就不存在，那就完事了，
cues.en: And if you think of it that way, oh well, if the variable doesn't exist already, we're done,

cues.zh: 干净利落，没有损害，也不算错。
cues.en: clean, no harm, no foul.

cues.zh: 呃，所以我本应该那么做。
cues.en: Uh, and so that's what I should have done.

cues.zh: 本不该抛出那个异常。
cues.en: should not have thrown that exception.

cues.zh: 另一个例子是文件删除。
cues.en: Another example is file deletion.

cues.zh: 在 Windows 里，至少在早期，如果你想删除一个文件
cues.en: In Windows, at least in the early days, if you're trying to delete a file

cues.zh: 如果某个进程正打开着这个文件，
cues.en: when some process had the file open,

cues.zh: 那是不允许的。
cues.en: that was not allowed.

cues.zh: 有人遇到过吗，这里用 Windows 的人遇到过吗？
cues.en: Anybody experienced this, anybody here using Windows experienced this?

cues.zh: 这玩意儿太糟糕了。
cues.en: It's this horrible thing.

cues.zh: 然后你会想：好吧，谁把它打开了？你开始到处杀进程，想让文件能删掉。
cues.en: And then, now you think, okay, who's got it open? You start going around killing programs to try and make it so you can delete the file.

cues.zh: 你找不到是哪个程序打开着它，最后只好放弃，重启。
cues.en: And you can't find which program has it open, so finally you just give up, and you reboot.

cues.zh: 然后结果发现，结果发现
cues.en: And then it turns out, and then it turns out that

cues.zh: 是某个系统守护进程打开了这个文件。
cues.en: it's a system daemon that has the file open.

cues.zh: 所以你重启之后，它仍然
cues.en: So when you reboot it still,

cues.zh: 在使用中，你还是删不掉它。
cues.en: in use, you can't delete it.

cues.zh: 所以，Unix 有一个漂亮、非常讨巧的解决方案
cues.en: So, Unix had a has a beautiful, really lovely solution

cues.zh: 能让这个错误消失。
cues.en: that makes this error go away.

cues.zh: 在 Unix 里，如果你在文件打开时删除它，实际发生的是，它会把文件
cues.en: In Unix, if you delete a file while it's open, what happens is it deletes the file

cues.zh: 从目录和命名空间中删掉，它不再出现在文件系统的任何地方，
cues.en: from the directory, and from the name space, it no longer appears anywhere in the file system,

cues.zh: 但文件的实际内容仍然保留，因此任何正在使用该文件的进程都能继续访问它。
cues.en: but the actual contents of the file still hang around, so that any process that's using the file can continue to access the file.

cues.zh: 然后，当文件的最后一个打开实例被关闭时，它最终会清理并丢弃
cues.en: And then when the last uh open instance of the file is closed, then finally it cleans up and throws away

cues.zh: 其余所有内容。
cues.en: everything else.

cues.zh: 所以这是个很妙的解决方案，因为你本可能犯另一种错误，
cues.en: So a lovely solution because you could have made the other mistake,

cues.zh: 也就是：我要删除这个文件，于是现在任何对该文件做 IO 的人都会遇到错误。
cues.en: which is that, I'm going to delete the file, and now anybody doing IO on the file gets an error.

cues.zh: 那可能反而更糟，因为现在每个程序都必须写成
cues.en: That would probably be even worse because now every program would have to be written

cues.zh: 能处理你正在访问文件时文件突然消失的情况。
cues.en: to handle the case where the file goes away in the middle of your accessing it.

cues.zh: 所以，Unix 有这样一个漂亮、简单的接口。
cues.en: So, Unix had this beautiful, simple interface.

cues.zh: 这只是一个漂亮、非常讨喜的例子。
cues.en: It's only a a beautiful, really lovely example.
